howto: Pick your age band, Math or Spelling, and a track, then Play.
Hold accelerate and steer to stay on the road.
Green boost pads put a question at the top and four balloons on the road ahead.
Drive through the balloon with the right answer for a rocket boost; a wrong one spins you out and shows a hint.
In Spelling, drive through the word's letters in order. Finish three laps.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the balloon question: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
A shield item skips your next question; oil slows the other karts for a few seconds.
Each lap the questions step up inside your age band, so the last lap is the hardest.
A wrong balloon costs speed, not the race: read the hint and nail it next time.
Checkpoints count in order: cut across the grass and the lap will not count.

controls.keyboard: Up or W accelerates, Down or S brakes, Left/Right or A/D steer; H shows a hint; R restarts; Esc returns to the menu; P pauses.
controls.touch: Hold ▲ to accelerate and ▼ to brake, ◀ ▶ steer; HINT sits top left.

difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and every lap steps up inside that range: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

settings.quality: Menu > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low draws at three-quarter resolution for slower devices; the choice is remembered)

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the menu; each lap ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button (H, or the arcade Hint): a make-a-ten, number-line, skip-count or next-sound nudge for the current balloon question; a wrong balloon also shows one
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the menu (all time) and on the Race Complete card (this race): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: Four-step coach on the first race (drive, boost pads, answer balloons, items); skip it or replay it from the menu
features.results: Race Complete card: placement, best lap, answer streak, correct / asked and the grown-up report
